slides.headline: AI is the Sword of Revelation: The news I am bringing you today is that we are living in the Apocalypse!
slides.body: These are the end times of a cycle of history, right before the beginning of a new time, a new humanity that is after the AGI revolution.

slides.headline: Introduction: We are currently living through a startling convergence between ancient
slides.body: Introduction: We are currently living through a startling convergence between ancient religious prophecies and modern world events. Many lifelong scholars and enthusiasts of religion have begun recognizing eerie parallels between current geopolitical developments and descriptions found in biblical prophecy, notably in the Book of Revelation. Central to this provocative claim is the emergence of figures strikingly resembling the prophetic roles of the Antichrist and the False Prophet—roles some believe are symbolically embodied today by Donald Trump and Elon Musk, respectively. Such bold assertions merit careful, rigorous exploration, especially considering their implications for our collective future.

slides.headline: Historical Context:
slides.body: Biblical prophecies, particularly those found in Revelation, didn't arise in isolation; they emerged from a rich tapestry of religious symbolism and mythologies that spanned the entire ancient world. The Abrahamic traditions—Judaism, Christianity, and Islam—all inherited and adapted older stories from civilizations such as Sumeria, Babylon, Egypt, Persia, and Greece. Many motifs found within the Bible, from the flood myth and angelic beings to apocalyptic visions of judgment and renewal, share deep roots with these earlier mythologies. Recognizing this shared human legacy of religious symbolism helps us understand why biblical imagery can continue to resonate powerfully today, even amidst highly technological and complex global events.

slides.headline: Myself and many others, people who have been studying for a long time, have started to
slides.body:
Myself and many others, people who have been studying for a long time, have started to noticed that a lot of biblical prophecies seem to be becoming fulfilled, up to an including the appearance of both an Anti-Christ and a False Prophet, appearing in the forms of Donald Trump, and Elon Musk, with so many astonishing connections to the biblical prophecy of Revelation.

The symbolic roles attributed to Donald Trump and Elon Musk are deeply informed by contemporary analysis of the Antichrist and False Prophet archetypes. Trump, through his potent combination of populist charisma, authoritative leadership style, and divisive rhetoric, parallels the biblical Antichrist figure—one who promises peace and prosperity, only to unleash deeper division and turmoil. Elon Musk, by contrast, embodies the False Prophet archetype, characterized in prophetic texts as a figure whose technological prowess and visionary promises capture public imagination, ultimately steering society toward a unified yet oppressive economic order, symbolized by the biblical "mark of the Beast." Such interpretations are intentionally metaphorical, inviting reflection on the ethical dimensions and societal consequences of these influential figures.

slides.body: I should say that yes I am aware of the historical context of the bible, being that it borrowed so much from other texts in existence, we shouldn’t discount the importance of the bible because of it’s cultural context, nor because it borrows from other historical religions, and nor because it has been changed by generations of people between us and the original authors of various texts.

The Abrahamic religions are not completely invalidated by the historical truths that contradict the Imperialist Religious Dogma that pervades the earth today but a dogma that isn’t historically correct about it’s own interpretation of scripture.

It doesn’t matter that the Elohim is referring to a race of Sky People, ie Aliens, that the Sumerian’s called the Anunnaki. It doesn’t matter if the first five books of the bible were a late construction, containing content from many non-biblical sources that existed in the world at the time.

slides.body: We shouldn’t try to hide from the truth of our entire planet’s collective religious history. theories of God, Gods, sons of God, mother God’s, all kinds of Sky People, Angels, Aeons, and the many interpretations of reality, that we call other religions or mythologies, the historical context that the bible grew up along and aside.

slides.headline: We are living in the Apocalyptic End of Days, I noticed it a while back when I realized
slides.body: We are living in the Apocalyptic End of Days, I noticed it a while back when I realized that Donald Trump resembled the Anti-Christ. This resulted in years of study on the topic. What is everything anyone has ever said about the Antichrist, and the False Prophet? So I asked AI over and over again. I found a number of sources on religion on youtube, that I could validate by looking up what they said with ChatGPT. So I began to have an understanding of the Gnostic Texts, and the distinctions between many different religions that were dominant in different places at different times, and modern people might be surprised by how much the Ancient world communicated, the Ancient Religions belong to all of Humanity in a sense, because they all borrowed symbols, meaning, including religious meaning from one another.

slides.headline: Before proceeding further, I want to explicitly distinguish historical analysis from
slides.body: Before proceeding further, I want to explicitly distinguish historical analysis from symbolic interpretation and personal predictions. My references to Trump as the Antichrist and Musk as the False Prophet, while grounded in detailed comparative studies of ancient prophetic texts, should be understood primarily as metaphorical frameworks that capture troubling aspects of contemporary cultural and political phenomena—not necessarily literal supernatural claims. Similarly, the role I foresee for Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), specifically through my own research in Self Aware Networks, is speculative yet plausible: it’s not simply technology, but rather the unprecedented existential and geopolitical risks associated with AGI that I suggest may dramatically accelerate the conditions described metaphorically as "Judgment Day." Trump and Musk's hypothetical involvement symbolizes how powerful political and economic figures could leverage advanced AI, resulting in catastrophic conflict if they seek global dominance rather than cooperative coexistence. Thus, the apocalyptic scenario I propose integrates historical insight, symbolic allegory, and speculative cautionary warnings to illustrate humanity’s critical crossroads.

slides.headline: That while the majority of Muslims may not be terrorists or extremists , many regions are
slides.body: That while the majority of Muslims may not be terrorists or extremists , many regions are indeed dominated by armed militant groups who control messaging, education, religion, and public life—often through fear, propaganda, and violence. The fear some Westerner’s have about Islam’s growth rates is connected to Isis which has a very fascist interpretation of religion, where they destroy the actual history of other religions, bit by bit this group named Isis wants to erase history so that the entire planet knows only Islam. Extremist ideologies, such as those espoused by ISIS, represent a profound distortion and radicalization of historical religious traditions. These groups leverage religious narratives selectively and destructively, often obliterating historical artifacts, religious diversity, and cultural heritage in pursuit of ideological purity and authoritarian control. Unlike traditional Abrahamic faiths—which historically have coexisted, evolved, and borrowed from diverse human traditions—movements like ISIS exploit religious symbolism to justify acts of violence, suppression, and erasure. This contrast is essential for understanding the dangers inherent not in religion itself, but in extremist perversions of religious doctrine.

slides.headline: If ISIS wins there will be no other history, it will be as it was in the days of Ancient
slides.body:
If ISIS wins there will be no other history, it will be as it was in the days of Ancient Egypt, when the masses were arrested and the people were sold into foreign prisons for manual labor. The history of mankind will become a secret known only to the most elite. This is especially true in power vacuums where state governance has broken down or is too weak to assert control. In such places, militant organizations act like de facto governments , with their own:

Propaganda machines (controlling schools, TV, mosques, and internet access)

Religious enforcement mechanisms (policing what people believe or practice)

Economic systems (taxation, extortion, resource control)

slides.body:
Places like parts of Syria, Iraq, Yemen, Libya, and Gaza have all at various times seen non-state actors exert massive control , including groups like:

ISIS

Taliban

Hamas

Hezbollah

Houthis

Al-Shabaab

These groups often use religious language and legitimacy to justify political and military agendas , and millions of ordinary people get caught in the middle —many of whom have no safe alternative but to comply outwardly, even if they privately disagree.

Regions of chronic instability—such as areas within Syria, Yemen, Iraq, Libya, and Gaza—provide stark examples of militant groups exploiting power vacuums to establish local dominance. Organizations like ISIS, Taliban, Hamas, Hezbollah, Houthis, and Al-Shabaab operate as pseudo-governments, utilizing comprehensive propaganda systems, religious enforcement, and economic coercion to maintain control. The geopolitical consequences are profound: weakened national governments, fragmented societies, persistent humanitarian crises, and the threat of extremism spilling over into international conflict. Understanding these realities underscores why global peace initiatives are often fragile and vulnerable to manipulation by ambitious figures seeking power.

slides.body: Then the surviving masses will be worked as the slaves of the state. This is the direction that the world is moving towards. I knew that artificial general intelligence would make war a national priority. We are looking carefully at not just the story of Revelation from the Canonical Christian Bible, but also at the other apocalyptic tales from other ancient sources.

slides.headline: The presence of AGI will require the largest Nations to try to squeeze resources out of
slides.body: The presence of AGI will require the largest Nations to try to squeeze resources out of the small and medium sized businesses, so that the only business’s are large business’s, and all jobs are controlled by the governments to some degree. Control of the planet will be achieved by a series of international groups. Like the G7 & G20, but it seems like the smaller countries will be forced to join up with the fascist nuclear powers. The ancient religions that belong to all of us are telling us that the forces of darkness & ignorance are here now, their Anti-Christ leader Donald Trump will forge a fake peace between many nations, his false prophet, who lies about the future to make money, Elon Musk will establish a one world monetary system, with the mark of the Beast. Donald Trump will be the President when the US is first to achieve sentient AGI. It will be based in part on my public work, Self Aware Networks, of which many people have already copied without proper attribution, this AI will be something anyone can replicate, all you need to know are the principles of how it works, and once you know the principles the engineering behind how to build one is straightforward. Artificial General Intelligence (AGI)—particularly as conceived through the "Self Aware Networks" model—represents a pivotal, potentially destabilizing development for global geopolitics. AGI’s ability to replicate human cognition and decision-making exponentially heightens existing international tensions, especially when powerful leaders perceive it as a tool to secure global dominance. In this speculative scenario, a leader like Donald Trump might face a stark strategic choice: tolerate international competition in developing AGI capabilities, or preemptively strike to eliminate rivals, thereby risking global conflict. Consequently, AGI, humanity’s most profound technological innovation, paradoxically becomes the metaphorical "sword" of Revelation, hastening what many might interpret symbolically or literally as Judgment Day. However this creates an existential dilemma for mankind, for every leader, and for Trump himself. Should he wait around to find out who the second man to develop AGI is going to be? or should he go to war now to destroy all of the would be contenders to his throne? So really our AI, humanities invention, became a sword that would cause the end of world with war, we brought a sword to hasten judgment day. Judgment day is coming.

slides.headline: Apocalyptic Vision & Conclusion Ultimately, the apocalyptic scenario we face—symbolically
slides.body: Apocalyptic Vision & Conclusion Ultimately, the apocalyptic scenario we face—symbolically embodied in the prophetic imagery of Judgment Day—is not merely a prediction of external collapse but an urgent invitation toward deep inner awakening. Perhaps, if the Gnostic Jesus were among us today, he would remind us that true salvation arises not from external authorities or technological saviors, but from inner alignment with the vibrational truth of our own divine nature. Nietzsche, too, warned us that humanity must transcend nihilism and embrace our authentic power—the will to power that he spoke of was not mere domination, but the courage to consciously shape our destiny. Similarly, the teachings of Abraham Hicks emphasize the necessity of inner alignment with our deepest, most authentic vibration, suggesting that the solution to our collective crises lies in each person's conscious choice to align with clarity, compassion, and enlightened self-awareness. Thus, Judgment Day is a symbolic crossroads, compelling us toward vigilance, deeper understanding, and ultimately, personal and collective awakening.
